_fixtureNotice: Authored test fixtures for saucedemo.com E2E validation. These issues are hand-written by a person describing real saucedemo.com flows (login, inventory, sort, cart, checkout, product details) for the platform's own testing -- they are NOT exported from a real JIRA instance. Issue keys use the SAUCE- prefix so provenance is self-evident on sight.

fields.summary: As a user, I want to log in with valid, locked-out, or invalid credentials, so that only authorized standard users can reach the inventory page.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given the login page is displayed, when the user enters the standard_user username with password secret_sauce and submits the form, then the user is redirected to the inventory page.
AC2 (negative): Given the login page is displayed, when the user enters the locked_out_user username with password secret_sauce and submits the form, then the page displays the error 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' and the user remains on the login page.
AC3 (negative, boundary): Given the login page is displayed, when the user submits the form with an invalid username/password combination, or with either field left blank, then the page displays a username/password error message and no session is established.

fields.summary: As a logged-in user, I want to view the full product inventory, so that I can browse items available for purchase.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given a user has logged in as standard_user, when the inventory page loads, then all six catalog products are displayed, each showing a name, price, description, and image.
AC2 (negative, boundary): Given a user is not logged in, when the user navigates directly to the inventory page URL, then the user is redirected back to the login page and no product data is shown.

fields.summary: As a user, I want to sort the product catalog by name and by price, so that I can find products in the order I prefer.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given the inventory page is displayed, when the user selects the 'Name (A to Z)' sort option, then products are re-ordered alphabetically ascending by name.
AC2 (positive): Given the inventory page is displayed, when the user selects the 'Name (Z to A)' sort option, then products are re-ordered alphabetically descending by name.
AC3 (positive): Given the inventory page is displayed, when the user selects the 'Price (low to high)' sort option, then products are re-ordered by ascending price.
AC4 (positive): Given the inventory page is displayed, when the user selects the 'Price (high to low)' sort option, then products are re-ordered by descending price.

fields.summary: As a user, I want to add and remove products from my cart, so that I can manage what I intend to purchase before checkout.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given a product is shown on the inventory page, when the user clicks 'Add to cart', then the cart badge count increments by one and the button changes to 'Remove'.
AC2 (positive): Given a product is already in the cart, when the user clicks 'Remove', then the cart badge count decrements by one and the button changes back to 'Add to cart'.
AC3 (positive, boundary): Given a user has added products to the cart, when the user navigates away from the inventory page and back again, then the cart contents and badge count are unchanged.

fields.summary: As a user, I want to complete checkout by providing my first name, last name, and zip code, so that I can finish purchasing the items in my cart.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given a cart containing at least one product, when the user provides a valid first name, last name, and zip code on the checkout information step and completes the order, then an order confirmation ('Thank you for your order!') is displayed and the cart is emptied.
AC2 (negative): Given the checkout information step is displayed, when the user submits the form with the first name field left blank, then the error 'Error: First Name is required' is shown and checkout does not proceed.
AC3 (negative): Given the checkout information step is displayed, when the user submits the form with the zip/postal code field left blank, then the error 'Error: Postal Code is required' is shown and checkout does not proceed.
AC4 (negative, boundary): Given the cart is empty, when the user attempts to proceed to checkout, then the system prevents the checkout flow from starting with an empty order.

fields.summary: problem_user sees mismatched, broken product images across the inventory grid.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (negative): Given a user has logged in as problem_user, when the inventory page loads, then every product tile incorrectly renders the same broken/placeholder image asset instead of its own product photo, reproducing the defect.
AC2 (negative, boundary): Given a user has logged in as problem_user, when the inventory page images are inspected, then image alt text is missing or incorrect on the affected tiles, compounding the accessibility gap.

fields.summary: As a user, I want to view a single product's details page, so that I can review its price and description before adding it to the cart.
fields.description:
Acceptance Criteria:
AC1 (positive): Given the inventory page is displayed, when the user clicks a product's name or image, then the product details page shows that product's name, description, price, and image.
AC2 (positive): Given the product details page is displayed, when the user clicks 'Add to cart', then the cart badge count increments by one without leaving the details page.
